leadText: Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi (Japanese: 水内清光 Mizuuchi Kiyomitsu) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi (Japanese: 水内清光 Mizuuchi Kiyomitsu) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Mizuuchi was born on November 17, 1960, in , . He started work on the with , where he voiced recurring antagonist Viren. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
